df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
p = df.pivot_table(index='date', columns=['instance_family'], values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum')
target = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16')
# baseline: same weekday before and after? Use robust z per row using surrounding window excluding target
res=[]
for col in p.columns:
    s = p[col]
    base = s.drop(target)
    # use window +-14 days around target excluding target
    w = base[(base.index>=target-pd.Timedelta(days=21)) & (base.index<=target+pd.Timedelta(days=21))]
    m, sd = w.mean(), w.std()
    z = (s[target]-m)/sd if sd>0 else 0
    res.append((col, s[target], m, z))
res.sort(key=lambda x:-x[3])
for r in res[:15]: print(r)
